attr.title: Horizon Chase
attr.desc: Horizon Chase Android 2.6.9 compatibility loader for TrimUI Brick running NextUI. Includes the PowerVR SDL presentation fix, manual bottom-button acceleration, audio, persistent saves, and a 60 FPS lifecycle target. BYO-data; game files are not included.
attr.inst: Extract the ZIP into /mnt/SDCARD/Roms/Ports (PORTS), put a legal Horizon Chase Android 2.6.9 APK/APKM/APKS/XAPK and all required splits in .ports/horizonchase/gamedata, then launch Horizon Chase. NXExtract validates and prepares the owner-supplied data automatically.
